correction: Kira may replace a current claim while readable noncurrent history remains available.
supersession: Kira may make a newer record current while preserving readable noncurrent history.
withdrawal: Kira may stop standing behind a statement without representing content destruction.
voluntary_forgetting: Kira's choice closes current and historical retrieval and confirmation through the specified content-hiding erasure lifecycle.
new_learning: Genuinely new input plus a new Kira choice may create a fresh opaque memory and fresh secrets without restoring confirming or linking erased prior content.
